RESONANCE 3.0 — ALUMNI INTERACTION
body:
Ever wondered what life is like after college? What skills actually matter in the industry? How to crack internships and placements? Or what you should be doing right now to build your career?

Resonance 3.0 brings our alumni back to campus to share their experiences, insights, mistakes, achievements, and lessons from their journey beyond FISAT.

✨ What you can expect: * Real-world industry experiences * Internship & placement insights * Career guidance & industry expectations * Skills you should start building now * Tips for resumes, interviews & networking * Higher studies, jobs & career opportunities * Open interaction with our alumni

👨‍💻 For: All CSE Students 📅 Date: 8 September 2026 ⏰ Time: 1:30 PM – 3:30 PM 📍 Venue: Main Seminar Hall

🔥 Register Now: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeEh0OKtPrjwPvWbe5g-D1tyqM3nyDh4puvtAWKRMmcY0BdFw/viewform

Whether you’re just starting your journey or preparing to step into the industry, there’s something for everyone.

Come, connect with our alumni, ask questions, and get a glimpse of what lies beyond the campus.

RESONANCE 3.0 Connect. Learn. Grow.
